extraction.notes: Company reports FFO and Core FFO only; no AFFO metric, so affo fields are null. The FFO section starts from net loss available to common shareholders and the diluted FFO line (23,332) adds Series D preferred dividends after the FFO subtotal; the extracted FFO total is the pre-dilution 23,172 subtotal. Same figures appear on the duplicate page seq 56 (printed 102). Interest rate swap amortization was classed as derivative_mtm (hedge-related); it could alternatively be debt_cost_amortization. 'Other miscellaneous items' (footnote: gain/loss on investments and one-time professional fees) was classed as other. 'Loss on sale of real estate' and 'Redemption of preferred shares' are shown as dashes (zero) for 3/31/2025. Recurring capex: no AFFO section; the portfolio summary (page S-13) shows Total Recurring Capital Expenditures per Apartment Home for Same-Store of $172, a per-unit figure only with no company-total dollar amount, so recurring_capex_disclosed left null. Check: 23,332/19,876 = 1.17 and 24,139/19,876 = 1.21, matching reported per-share figures.
